title: At the Park
description: Three short recordings about children playing at the park.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Going to the park
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and her dad.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Dad, can we go to the park?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Yes! It is sunny today.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Can I take my bike?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: No, Mai. Take your ball.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: OK, Dad. Let us go!

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Wear your hat, Mai. The sun is hot.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: OK, Dad. I have my hat and my water.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Have fun, and play in the sunshine. I will sit and read.

parts.title: Part 2 · In the park
parts.intro: You will hear Mai talking about the park.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I can see a big tree and two ducks.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: The ducks are on the lake. They are white.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: There is a boy on the swing. He is happy.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: There are many flowers near the tree. They are pink and red.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I love this park. It is so nice.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: The grass is green and very soft. I like to run on it.

parts.title: Part 3 · A new friend
parts.intro: You will hear Mai and a boy called Minh.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Hello! Do you want to play?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Yes, please! What is your name?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: I am Minh. I am seven.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I am seven too! Let us play with my ball.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Great! I love football.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Do you come here every day, Minh?

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Yes, with my big sister. She is over there.

script.speaker: Minh
script.text: Tomorrow I want to bring my kite. It is red.
